scope: Shared frontend panorama processor TS/WASM orchestration only; no new parsing algorithm, renderer changes, backend conversion logic or Go changes.
changes: Each open owns its reader, manifest, controller, companion and track mapping. Replacement installs a new state before aborting/disposing the previous state; obsolete errors cannot clear the replacement.
Publish the manifest only after primary and companion inspection both succeed. Failed opens dispose only their own state and remain reusable.
Keep the original open signal active through subsequent reads, sensor development and seam/IMU work; operation signals cancel only their operation.
Pass operation signals to the shared WASM runner, covering asynchronous module loading and instantiation without cancelling shared compilation for other callers.
Race non-cooperative source probes, response bodies and Blob/range reads against cancellation. Observe late failures and cancel late response bodies without blocking on their streams.
Snapshot source/track/vendor ownership for an IMU batch instead of consulting mutable processor state between reads.
Release combined-signal fallback listeners after every operation or source disposal. Empty samples return empty bytes without an invalid HTTP range request.
Validate full-body byte count and the 64 MiB fallback budget, accounting for browser-decoded HTTP bodies retaining the compressed Content-Length header.

browserCoverage: Built processor library with actual remote DNG Range requests; abort after open rejects RAW decode before loading image WASM, and reopen develops a 1024x512 JPEG
Non-cooperative real source probe settles before its held response is released; late response body is cancelled while replacement ONE RS state remains current
One seam caller cancels during a shared real module load; other caller succeeds and subsequent invocation reuses the same load
Existing URL/context release, late image replacement, real ordinary DNG conversion/abort, spherical NASA video playback retirement and demo panorama-to-flat-image checks
Synthetic ONE RS/X5 DNG direction, static seam readiness, resize and switch back to ordinary public DNG, in development and production
warnings: Existing duplicate Three.js instance warning in Vue tests
Existing demo vendor chunk size warning

contentEquivalence.method: Bundle previous/current processor sources against the same installed converter runtime, compile unchanged production WASM once, then compare complete manifests and developed JPEG bytes. Synthetic fixtures and one public ordinary DNG; no private originals. This is correctness validation, without timing or visual-quality/SOTA ranking.

limits: This is correctness and cancellation coverage; no elapsed-time, throughput, memory or peer/SOTA measurement is added. Cases at or below 10 ms are not promoted as speed gains.
Already-running synchronous WASM/JS cannot be interrupted. Non-cooperative asynchronous work can finish later; output is discarded and late rejection observed.

Track/metadata cancellation tests inject descriptors into synthetic DNG manifests. They establish operation ownership, not support for additional real video formats, metadata variants or camera originals.
Content equivalence covers three synthetic DNGs and one public Pentax DNG. Private camera-original panorama quality is not re-evaluated.
HTTP Content-Encoding control supplies already-decoded bytes to model the browser contract; browser range checks use actual 206 responses.
reproduction: Restore diagnostic baselineFiles at their repository-relative paths, or reverse panorama-processor.patch only in an isolated checkout preserving earlier work. Never reverse it in the current working checkout.
